name: Satellite TLS certificate rotation
description: Unsupported content, run at your own risk. satellite-installer restarts Satellite services: no web UI, no content delivery, no remote execution while it runs. Do not run outside an approved change window.

spec.question_description: Selects the Capsule installer flags. 6.16 and 6.17 also pass --foreman-proxy-register-in-foreman.
true runs the certificate validation on the Satellite and stops. Nothing is restarted.

spec.question_name: I accept that Satellite services will restart and be unavailable
spec.question_description: Required before anything is deployed. Content delivery, the web UI, and remote execution are down for the duration of each installer run.

spec.question_name: Allow the certificate authority to change
spec.question_description: Only select true if the new CA has ALREADY been deployed to every registered host and Capsule. Otherwise those hosts lose their connection to Satellite.

spec.question_name: Skip servers already serving this certificate
spec.question_description: Compared by serial number. false forces a redeployment, which restarts services even when nothing changes.
URL Capsules use to reach the Satellite Server, for example https://satellite.example.com.
Hard limit for a single satellite-installer run. Raise it for large deployments.
